Has the user shove the designated opposing Pokémon and lock on it. The locked-on opposing Pokémon will have its movement speed decreased and take increased damage. After a set amount of time, this move deals damage to the locked-on opposing Pokémon based on the amount of damage it took while locked on.

Upgrade (Level 11): The locked-on enemy instead takes 15% increased damage.
mewtwoy.psystrike:
Has the user direct psychic waves at the designated opposing Pokémon, dealing damage to it and decreasing its movement speed. At the end of the move, the user hits the designated opposing Pokémon and nearby opposing Pokémon with a strong psychic wave, throwing and dealing damage to all opposing Pokémon it hits. The farther the user is from the designated opposing Pokémon, the more damage this move deals.

Upgrade (Level 11): Movement speed reduction on enemies is increased to 15% for 1s, stacking up to 5 times.
mewtwoy.barrier: Grants the user a shield for a short time. While the shield effect is active, the user's movement speed is increased.
mewtwoy.recover:
Grants the user a shield for a short time. While the shield effect is active, the user's movement speed is increased, and the user recovers HP based on the amount of damage it deals with basic attacks. When the shield effect is removed after a set amount of time, all of the user's move cooldowns are reduced, and the Mega gauge increases.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases the amount of HP recovered to 50% of damage dealt with Basic Attacks.
mewtwoy.teleport:
The user teleports to the designated location. For a short time, the user's movement speed and damage dealt increase, and its basic attacks increase the Mega gauge by a greater amount. After using this move, for a short time, this move can be used again once only.

Upgrade (Level 13): Damage dealt is increased to 30%.
mewtwoy.infinite psyburn: Has the user bring down one powerful psychic blast upon each opposing Pokémon. Opposing Pokémon around each point of impact take damage, are left unable to act, and have their Sp. Def. decreased for a short time.
mewtwoy.pressure: When the Pokémon deals damage to an opposing Pokémon with a basic attack, the Mega gauge increases. The more the Mega gauge increases, the more the Pokémon's Sp. Atk. and basic attack speed increase. If the Mega gauge becomes full when the Pokémon is Lv. 5 or higher, the Pokémon Mega Evolves for a set amount of time. When the Pokémon Mega Evolves, its Sp. Atk and basic attack speed increase even more, and its movement speed increases. The more Aeos energy that's consumed (maximum of 30 Aeos energy), the longer the Pokémon remains Mega Evolved (maximum of 15 seconds).

mimikyu.basic attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, striking twice with an increased area of attack. The next basic attack after using a move becomes a boosted attack.
mimikyu.astonish: Has the user shout in a startling fashion, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon.
mimikyu.play rough:
Has the user jump forward, then move around opposing Pokémon it hits, dealing damage multiple times and decreasing their movement speed for a short time. After the attack is finished, the user jumps in the designated direction.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases Mimikyu's movement speed by 20% for 3s after the attack is finished.
mimikyu.shadow claw:
Has the user slash in front of itself with sharp claws, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits, decreasing their movement speed, and restoring the user's HP. Whenever the user hits opposing Pokémon with a basic attack, this move's cooldown is reduced, and the number of times the user attacks when this move is used next increases (maximum 4 times). The movement speed decreases caused by this move can stack.

Upgrade (Level 11): At the end of the move, deal an additional hit of damage equal to 12% of missing HP. This damage is capped at 500 against wild Pokémon.
mimikyu.scratch: Has the user charge in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and decreasing their movement speed for a short time. For a short time after the user charges, if this move is used again, the user attacks in front of itself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits. At that time, additional damage is dealt based on the percentage of HP that the opposing Pokémon has lost.
mimikyu.shadow sneak:
Has the user extend its shadow, marking an opposing Pokémon it hits as a shadow target for a short time. If the shadow passes through tall grass or a wall, it extends further. If the user deals damage to an opposing Pokémon marked as a shadow target, additional damage is dealt based on the percentage of HP that the opposing Pokémon has lost. If this move is used again, the user moves to an opposing Pokémon marked as a shadow target, deals damage to it, and extends the duration of that Pokémon's shadow mark. If the user knocks out a Pokémon marked as a shadow target, this move's cooldown is reset and the user recovers HP.

Upgrade (Level 13): Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s.
mimikyu.trick room:
Has the user create a bizarre area around itself. If a movement speed decrease is applied to the user while it is within the area, that effect is converted into a movement speed increase, and the user takes reduced damage from Pokémon outside the area. Also, while in the area, the user can use this move again to move a set distance forward, as often as desired.

Upgrade (Level 13): Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s.
Has the user leap at an opposing Pokémon and trap it inside its rag, dealing damage over time and granting the user a shield. The trapped opposing Pokémon isn't affected by any Pokémon's moves except the user's. If the user loses its shield, or if a set amount of time passes, the user stops attacking and jumps in the designated direction.
mimikyu.disguise: When the Pokémon is in Disguised Form and takes damage from opposing Pokémon, the Pokémon with this Ability has its HP decreased by a set percentage of its remaining HP, nullifies damage for a set amount of time, and changes to Busted Form. At the same time, a revenge mark is applied to the opposing Pokémon that dealt the damage. The Pokémon with this Ability increases in movement speed when approaching revenge-marked opposing Pokémon and deals increased damage to them. If the Pokémon remains in Busted Form for a set amount of time, it returns to Disguised Form. If the Pokémon knocks out an opposing Pokémon, the time it takes to return to Disguised Form is decreased.

miraidon.thunder shock: Has the user send a jolt of electricity in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits.
miraidon.charge beam:
Has the user charge power before firing an electric beam in the designated direction. If this move hits opposing Pokémon, the user's Sp. Atk. is increased for a short time, and the user stores electric power. If the user stores electric power twice within a short time, it can use a boosted version of Charge Beam. The boosted version has the user continuously fire an electric beam in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this move.

Upgrade (Level 11): Reduces the cooldown to charge by 0.5s.
miraidon.electro drift:
Has the user race forward in the designated direction while spinning, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in its path. The user also stores electric power. If the user stores electric power twice within a short time, it can use a boosted version of Electro Drift. The boosted version has the user do a spinning attack aimed at the designated opposing Pokémon, dealing damage to any opposing Pokémon it hits. This move deals increased damage if the opposing Pokémon's remaining HP is low. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this move.

Upgrade (Level 11): Reduces the cooldown to charge by 4s.
miraidon.thunder wave: Has the user discharge electricity at the designated opposing Pokémon, dealing damage and leaving them paralyzed.
miraidon.thunder:
Has the user summon a cloud in the skies above that drops wicked thunderbolts. The summoned cloud moves slowly toward the nearest opposing Pokémon, dropping thunderbolts whenever a set amount of time passes. The thunderbolts deal damage and apply a slowing effect to opposing Pokémon they hit.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases the slow effect to 20%.
miraidon.parabolic charge:
Has the user flood the area around it with electricity, dealing damage and applying a slowing effect to opposing Pokémon it hits. If this move hits opposing Pokémon, the user recovers HP and also recovers 1 stored use of either Charge Beam or Electro Drift. The more opposing Pokémon the move hits, the more HP the user recovers.

Upgrade (Level 13): Grants a shield when this move is used.
miraidon.bright future meteor storm: Has the user call down 5 meteorites in a row, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon they hit. If a meteorite hits an opposing Pokémon, the next meteorite to fall will deal increased damage. The final meteorite deals higher damage in a wider area of effect and throws opponents.
miraidon.hadron engine: When the Pokémon with this Ability hits a Pokémon from the opposing team with a move, it creates Electric Terrain. The Pokémon can consume a portion of its collected Aeos energy to expand the area of the Electric Terrain it creates. If the Pokémon with this Ability or its allies are within the Electric Terrain, their attacks deal additional damage and they cannot be put to sleep. Electric Terrain strengthens ally team goals and weakens opposing team goals. The Ability goes on cooldown after it's triggered.

moltres.basic attack: Becomes a boosted attack every 0 attacks, dealing increased damage when it hits. When a boosted attack hits Pokémon from the opposing team, the user can use one move instantly, and the Unite Move gauge charges slightly.
moltres.wing attack: Has the user spread its wings and charge in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon.
moltres.sky attack:
Has the user spread its wings wide and attack with a powered-up dash in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon. When this move hits Pokémon from the opposing team, then for a short time, the more Pokémon from the opposing team the move hits, the more the user's Defense and Sp. Def are increased.

Upgrade (Level 13): Grants a shield on a successful hit for 3s.
moltres.incinerate: Has the user hurl a fiery orb in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon. The higher the burn counter of the opposing Pokémon it hits, the more damage it deals. When this move hits an opposing Pokémon, that Pokémon's burn counter resets.
moltres.heat wave:
Has the user exhale hot breath in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and gradually restoring the user's HP for a short time. The higher the burn counter of the opposing Pokémon it hits, the more damage it deals. When this move hits an opposing Pokémon, that Pokémon's burn counter resets.

Upgrade (Level 11): Lowers the cooldown of this move by 1s for each Pokémon from the opposing team hit.
moltres.firebird inferno: Has the user soar upward and unleash a blazing orb of fire toward the designated area, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and maximizing their burn counter. After this move is used, the area around the opponents' scorable goal zones will become visible to the user.
moltres.flame body: When a basic attack or move deals damage to opposing Pokémon, it leaves them burned and increases their burn counter.

morpeko.hunger switch: This Pokémon's form and move effects change depending on its fullness gauge. When the Pokémon changes form, its move cooldowns are reset. Eating Berries will also increase the Pokémon's fullness gauge. Full Belly Mode: Upon entering this form, the Pokémon recovers some of its HP. The fullness gauge will decrease over time and whenever the Pokémon uses moves. When the gauge reaches zero, the Pokémon goes berserk and enters Hangry Mode. Hangry Mode: Upon entering this form, the Pokémon applies a fear effect to nearby opposing Pokémon, and its movement speed is slightly increased. The fullness gauge will increase over time, and when the Pokémon is full, it will eat the seeds stored in its pocket-like pouches to enter Full Belly Mode.
morpeko.thunder shock: Has the user attack the designated Pokémon and nearby opposing Pokémon with a jolt of electricity, dealing damage and leaving them paralyzed for a short time.
morpeko.spark:
Has the user attack the designated opposing Pokémon by unleashing a spark of electricity, dealing damage, applying a bolt mark, and leaving them paralyzed for a short time. Full Belly Mode: After unleashing a spark of electricity, for a short time, the user can perform a follow-up attack. The follow-up attack will have the user leap at the designated opposing Pokémon, dealing damage to them and nearby opposing Pokémon. When a follow-up attack is used, this move's cooldown is slightly reduced. Hangry Mode: Applies a bolt mark to the opposing Pokémon hit by this move.

Upgrade (Level 11): The user is granted a shield effect during the follow-up attack in Full Belly Mode.
morpeko.power trip: Has the user charge in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon. The user's next basic attack becomes a boosted attack.
morpeko.assurance:
Has the user charge in the designated direction and deal damage to opposing Pokémon. Additional damage is dealt to opposing Pokémon paralyzed by the user. Hangry Mode: When opposing Pokémon with a bolt mark are hit, the mark is consumed and this move's cooldown is reset,

Upgrade (Level 13): If this move hits, the next basic attack becomes a boosted attack and is guaranteed to be a critical hit.
morpeko.hungry supercharge wheel: Has the user attack by unleashing the energy stored in its cheeks and driving an electric wheel in the designated direction. Full Belly Mode: Has the user deal damage to opposing Pokémon it hits, leaving them paralyzed for a short time and unable to act. Hangry Mode: Has the user deal increased damage to opposing Pokémon it hits, applying a bolt mark and leaving them unable to act for a short time.

pawmot.basic attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, lunging at an opposing Pokémon and dealing increased damage.
pawmot.nuzzle: Has the user nuzzle its electrified cheeks against the designated opposing Pokémon, dealing damage and leaving them paralyzed.
pawmot.thunder punch:
Has the user unleash an electrified punch in the designated direction, dealing damage and applying a slowing effect to opposing Pokémon it hits. Fighter Mode: This move has a shorter range and no longer applies a slowing effect, but it deals increased damage.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases the damage dealt by this move.
pawmot.supercell slam:
Has the user electrify its body and dive toward the designated area, dealing damage and applying a slowing effect to opposing Pokémon it hits. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead. When this move hits, it can be used again, and the user unleashes a punch in front of itself, dealing damage and shoving opposing Pokémon it hits. Fighter Mode: The first stage of this move no longer applies a slowing effect, and its area of effect is decreased, but it deals increased damage.

Upgrade (Level 11): Strengthens the slowing effect to 40% for 2s.
pawmot.scratch: Has the user attack a designated opposing Pokémon with its sharp claws, dealing damage.
pawmot.volt switch:
Has the user cloak itself in electricity and charge into opposing Pokémon, dealing damage and moving behind them. After this move is used, for a short time, it can be used again once only. Fighter Mode: This move cannot be used repeatedly, but after it's used, the user's movement speed is increased.

Upgrade (Level 13): Reduce this move's cooldown by 1s.
pawmot.mach punch:
Has the user throw a punch at blinding speed, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon, shoving them, and leaving them unable to act. This move's cooldown is reduced every time a basic attack hits. Fighter Mode: This move no longer shoves or leaves opposing Pokémon unable to act, but the number of attacks for this move is increased.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases the length of time opposing Pokémon are left unable to act to 1s.
pawmot.zip zap full-charge spark: Has the user charge toward the designated Pokémon from the opposing team and discharge electricity stored in the user's fluffy fur, dealing damage to the Pokémon and nearby opposing Pokémon. After using this Unite Move, the user loses all the electricity stored in its fluffy fur and enters Fighter Mode for a set amount of time. The Unite Move gauge will only charge when the user's basic attacks and moves hit Pokémon from the opposing team. Fighter Mode: Basic attacks and move effects change, and the Unite Move gauge does not charge.
pawmot.iron fist: After this Pokémon hits with a move, the next auto attack will be enhanced, dealing increased damage and restoring the user's HP.

psyduck.basic attack: Attacks with a shot of water.
psyduck.confusion: Has the user release weak telekinetic force toward opposing Pokémon, dealing damage and leaving them unable to act. While the mysterious power is active, damage dealt to opposing Pokémon is increased.
psyduck.surf:
Has the user create a wave in the designated direction, dealing damage and applying a slowing effect to opposing Pokémon it hits. If opposing Pokémon hit by this move already have a slowing effect applied, they are shoved. The user can ride the wave for a short time and use basic attacks and moves while moving. Ally Pokémon who touch the wave have their movement speed increased. If this move is used again, the user stops in place and creates another wave. While the mysterious power is active, the user will create two waves.

Upgrade (Level 11): Decreases the damage dealt by opposing Pokémon hit by this move by 25% for 2.5s.
psyduck.bubble beam:
Has the user forcefully eject a spray of bubbles, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and attaching 3 bubbles. When ally Pokémon hit a bubbled opposing Pokémon with a basic attack, a bubble bursts, dealing damage. When all bubbles are burst, the opposing Pokémon is left unable to act. While the mysterious power is active, the damage dealt when the bubbles burst is increased.

Upgrade (Level 11): Decreases the movement speed of opposing Pokémon hit by the beam by 30% for 2s.
psyduck.tail whip: Has the user wag its tail, dealing damage, applying a slowing effect, and decreasing the Sp. Def. of the designated opposing Pokémon. While the mysterious power is active, the opposing Pokémon's Sp. Def. is decreased by a greater amount.
psyduck.disable:
Has the user release electricity that limits the designated opposing Pokémon's moves while dealing damage and leaving them unable to act. The electricity spreads to nearby Pokémon 4 times. (The electricity can only spread to the same Pokémon up to 1 times.) Opposing Pokémon hit by the electricity will have the cooldown of their last used move increased. If an opposing Pokémon haas no move on cooldown, the cooldown of the next move it uses will be increased. When an effect to increase a move's cooldown is applied, a slowing effect is also applied. While the mysterious power is active, the number of times the electricity spreads will increase.

Upgrade (Level 13): Strengthens the stun duration to 0.5s.
psyduck.psychic:
Has the user release a strong telekinetic force in the designated area, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and leaving them unable to act. The user continues to release a telekinetic force at the opposing Pokémon that took damage closest to the center of the area of effect. If this move is used again, the user pulls the opposing Pokémon receiving the telekinetic force in the designatedd direction. While the mysterious power is active, the user leaves the opposing Pokémon unable to act after pulling them.

Upgrade (Level 13): Decreases the Sp. Def of opposing Pokémon hit by the area of effect by 25% for 2s.
psyduck.full-power psy-ay-ay!: Has the user release three mysterious psychic waves around itself, dealing damage and decreasing the damage dealt by opposing Pokémon they hit. After using this move, the user's headache gauge greatly increases as a consequence of it unleashing its full power.
psyduck.swift swim: When the Pokémon is damaged by an opposing Pokémon, its movement speed is increased for a short time. This effect goes on cooldown after it's triggered. When this Pokémon or neaarby ally Pokémon take damage, the headache gauge increases. When the headache gauge is full, a mysterious power is triggered, shoving nearby opposing Pokémon. While the mysterious power is active, moves are boosted and their cooldowns are reduced.

quaquaval.pound: Has the user deal damage and decrease opposing Pokémon's movement speed.
quaquaval.wing attack: Has the user lunge at the designated opposing Pokémon, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. When this move deals damage to opposing Pokémon, the user receives a shield effect.
quaquaval.carnival splash: Has the user dance in place, pulling in opposing Pokémon, dealing damage, and leaving them unable to act. This move grants the user a shield effect. With each opposing Pokémon this move hits, vibes and this shield effect will increase. When this move causes vibes to reach max, Spinning Edge increased damage and grants the user a shield effect.
quaquaval.moxie: When the user's basic attacks and moves hit opposing Pokémon, vibes increase, which increase Attack. Vibes can increase to a maximum of 3, and they lower over time. When vibes reach max, the next basic attack becomes Spinning Edge. Each time Spinning Edge hit opposing Pokémon, the user's movement speed increases. This effect can stack up to 3 times.
quaquaval.low sweep:
Has the user unleash three swift kicks in the designated direction, dealing damage and decreasing opposing Pokémon's movement speed. When this move causes vibes to reach max, Spinning Edge deals increased damage.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases the damage dealt by this move and further increases the damage dealt by Spinning Edge when boosted.
quaquaval.liquidation:
Has the user charge in the designated direction, dealing damage and decreasing the Defense of opposing Pokémon it hits, and restoring the user's HP. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this move. When this move causes vibes to reach max, Spinning Edge grants the user a shield effect.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases the amount of HP restored by this move and strengthens the shield effect granted by Spinning Edge when boosted.

reshiram.turboblaze: Has the user attack with a blazing fireball, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and destroying a set amount of the opposing Pokémon's shield.
reshiram.dragon breath: Has the user exhale a mighty gust of breath in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and paralyzing them.
reshiram.blue flare:
Has the user attack in the designated direction by engulfing the target in intense, beautiful blue flames, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed and basic attack speed for a short time. Opposing Pokémon caught in the flames also take damage over time for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 13): Strengthens the decrease in movement speed and basic attack speed.
reshiram.tailwind: Has the user whip up a turbulent whirlwind and ride it in the designated direction.
reshiram.dragon dance:
Has the user move in the designated direction and gain a shield effect. Sp. Atk. increases for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 11): This move further increases Sp. Atk.
reshiram.flames that bring lightning: Has the user strike in the designated direction with a massive flame, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits. Every 2 this Unite Move is used, its next use will have the user strike with even mightier flames, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and leaving them unable to act. Zekrom will then rush to assist the user by attacking opposing Pokémon from outside the arena. A maximum of 3 can be kept in reserve for this move.

raichu.basic attack: If this Pokémon hits an opposing Pokémon with a basic attack or move, its boosted basic attack gauge increases by 1. When the boosted basic attack gauge reaches 4, the Pokémon's next basic attack becomes a boosted attack that deals increased damage and also deals damage to opposing Pokémon near its target (up to a maximum of 5 Pokémon) Alolan Raichu
raichu.thunder shock: Releases electricity at the designated opposing Pokémon, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. Also paralyzes opposing Pokémon for a short time.
raichu.stored power:
For a short time, increases the user's basic attack speed. The user's next 6 basic attacks also launch a star-shaped electric blast that deals additional damage.

Upgrade (Level 11): The electric blasts also decrease the target's Sp. Def by 8% for 3s (up to 3 times; maximum 24%).
raichu.electro ball:
Has the user hurl an electric orb to the designated location, where it remains for a short time. When an electric orb and an opposing Pokémon touch, the orb releases its electricity and deals damage to nearby opposing Pokémon. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this move.

Upgrade (Level 11): Deals damage every 0.5s over 3.5s (8 times) to opposing Pokémon hit by this move.
raichu.thunder wave: Has the user discharge a weak jolt of electricity in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and leaving them paralyzed for a short time.
raichu.thunderbolt:
Has the user release a strong electric blast in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and leaving them paralyzed. If this move hits an electric orb created by Electro Ball, the orb releases its electricity and deals damage to nearby opposing Pokémon.

Upgrade (Level 13): Immobilizes opposing Pokémon hit for 1s instead of paralyzing them.
raichu.psychic:
Has the user release a strong telekinetic force in the designated area, dealing damage and applying a slowing effect to opposing Pokémon it hits. If the user hits opposing Pokémon slowed by this effect with a basic attack, it deals additional damage. If this move hits an electric orb created by Electro Ball, the orb is pulled to the center of this move's area of effect.

Upgrade (Level 13): Creates a damage-over-time area of effect, damaging opposing Pokémon inside the area every 0.5s over 2s (up to 5 times).
raichu.thunderstorm aerial: Has the user create a star-shaped zone of electricity in the designated area, dealing damage and applying a slowing effect to opposing Pokémon it hits. The zone remains on the field for a short time, deals damage over time, and applies a slowing effect. If the user hits opposing Pokémon in the zone with a basic attack, the user's next basic attack becomes a boosted attack.
raichu.static: Upon receiving damage: paralyzes all nearby opposing Pokémon (30s CD).
raichu.surge surfer: The Pokémon can use basic attacks and moves while moving. When the Pokémon uses a move, a boosted basic attack, or a Unite Move, it dashes in the designated direction.

rapidash.basic attack: Attacks by shooting energy from its horn
rapidash.confusion: Has the user release a telekinetic force around itself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon. If this move hits opposing Pokémon, the user's movement speed is increased for a short time.
rapidash.dazzling gleam:
Has the user emit a powerful flash around itself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits. If opposing Pokémon are hit by the outer edge of the flash, the user's movement speed is increased for a short time. The increase is based on the number of opposing Pokémon hit. If the outer edge of the flash hits Pokémon on the opposing team, the user's movement speed is increased by a greater amount, and the cooldown of Tackle, Smart Strike, or Agility is reduced.

Upgrade (Level 11): Strengthens the cooldown reduction of Smart Strike or Agility to 50% of its current cooldown successively per Pokémon from the opposing team hit by the outer edge.
rapidash.fairy wind:
Has the user jump in the direction it's facing. When it lands, it stirs up a fairy wind that deals damage to nearby opposing Pokémon. This move can be used again, up to 2 times. If it's used 2 times, the final attack throws the opposing Pokémon it hits.

Upgrade (Level 11): Decreases the movement speed of opposing Pokémon hit by 20% for 2s with each use.
rapidash.tackle: Has the user charge, slamming into opposing Pokémon with its whole body while dealing damage and applying a slowing effect to them.
rapidash.smart strike:
Has the user stab the designated opposing Pokémon with its sharp horn, dealing damage to it. After that, the user leaps in the designated direction while shoving the opposing Pokémon in the opposite direction.

Upgrade (Level 13): Charges the user's psychic counter by 5 when this move hits.
rapidash.agility:
Increases the user's movement speed when used, and for a set amount of time, the user's movement speed continually increases. This move's duration increases if the user moves or hits opposing Pokémon with moves.

Upgrade (Level 13): Also restores 2% of the user's missing HP every 0.5s while their movement speed is increased by this move.
rapidash.triad blitz: Has the user charge in the designated direction, shoving Pokémon from the opposing team. When the charge ends, a mysterious space is created around the first opposing Pokémon that the user hit. That Pokémon cannot leave that space. If this move is used again, the user runs at high speed in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in its path. If its path goes through the mysterious space, this move can be used again an additional time. This move can be used again up to a total of 2 additional times.
rapidash.pastel veil: The Pokémon's psychic counter charges based on the distance they run (up to 10 times). When the counter is full, the Pokémon is granted a shield, becoming hindrance resistant while the shield remains.

scizor.basic attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, decreasing the movement speed of opposing Pokémon when it hits and increasing the user's Defense for a short time. This Defense increase can stack.
scizor.fury cutter: Has the user slash twice with its scythes in a cone in front of itself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits. The second slash deals more damage than the first.
scizor.dual wingbeat: Has the user slash in front of itself with both of its scythes, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the X-shaped area of effect. If this move deals damage to an opposing Pokémon in the center of the X-shaped area of effect, it restores the user's HP. If this move hits an opposing Pokémon, it can be used again within a set amount of time. If this move is used again, the user dashes in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it makes contact with. The dash deals more damage the lower the opposing Pokémon's HP is.
scizor.bullet punch:
Has the user dash in the designated direction and strike opposing Pokémon with tough punches. If this move hits opposing Pokémon, its cooldown is reduced, and the user recovers a portion of its HP based on the amount of damage dealt. If Bullet Punch is used again within a set amount of time, the number of punches and the amount of damage dealt increase. The number of punches increases from three to a maximum of five.

Upgrade (Level 11): Also grants a shield for 3s if this move hits an enemy.
scizor.quick attack: Has the user dash forward, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it makes contact with along the way.
scizor.double hit:
Has the user jump in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits during the jump and applying a mark to them. After the user hits opposing Pokémon with this move, it jumps again in the designated direction. When the user lands, its next basic attack becomes a boosted attack and it charges at a nearby opposing Pokémon. If a marked opposing Pokémon is knocked out, all of the user's move cooldowns are reduced.

Upgrade (Level 13): Reduces cooldown by 1s.
scizor.swords dance:
Has the user dash a short distance, increasing its Attack for a short time. While the user's Attack is increased, the user's eighth basic attack becomes an area-of-effect attack that pierces through opposing Pokémon in a line.

Upgrade (Level 13): Reduces the damage the user receives by 50% while dashing (0.3s).
scizor.green illusion dive: Has the user dash and attack a designated Pokémon on the opposing team, then create five illusory copies of itself that each dash a set distance from the user. The copies deal damage to opposing Pokémon they make contact with and apply a mark to them. After a short time, the copies return to the user, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon they make contact with. This move can be used again before the illusory copies return to the user. If it is used again, the user dashes in the designated direction and deals damage to opposing Pokémon it hits. At the end of the dash, the copies dash to the user's location. If a copy makes contact with an opposing Pokémon while dashing, the copy deals damage to that Pokémon and disappears. If a marked opposing Pokémon is knocked out, all of the user's move cooldowns are reduced.
scizor.red illusion dive: Has the user dash before throwing consecutive punches at a designated Pokémon on the opposing team, decreasing that Pokémon's movement speed. As the last punch is thrown, five illusory copies of the user are created that each dash a set distance from the user. If a copy hits an opposing Pokémon while dashing, it deals damage, decreases that Pokémon's movement speed, then disappears. For a short time, this move can be used again. If this move is used again, the user dashes in the designated direction and deals damage to opposing Pokémon it hits before punching the ground, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. If the user hits a Pokémon on the opposing team while dashing, the user grabs that Pokémon and continues dashing. If the grabbed Pokémon hits an illusory copy, it will be left incapacitated.

crustle.stealth rock:

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases the duration of this move's effects and decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time when this move hits.
crustle.x-scissor:
Has the user dash forward with crossed claws, dealing damge to opposing Pokémon multiple times and shoving them. Leaves opposing Pokémon unable to act if they hit an object when shoved.

crustle.rubble rouser: Grants the user a shield for a short time and elaves nearby opposing Pokémon unable to act, dealing them damage over time. If the user receives damage while this move is in effect, the move deals additional hits to nearby opposing Pokémon.
crustle.sturdy: Gains a stacking Def/SpDef buff for every 7% HP missing. Stacks up to 10 times.

decidueye.attack: Increases the speed of basic attacks by 3% for a short time after one hits. decidueye.leafage: Pelts leaves in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit by them. For a short time after using this move, the user's Attack and basic attack speed are increased.
decidueye.razor leaf:
Summons whirling razor leaves. For a short time after using this move, the user's Attack and basic attack speed are increased. In addition, the user's basic attacks can target multiple opposing Pokémon for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases the basic attack damage the higher the enemies' remaining HP is.
decidueye.spirit shackle:
Charges power before firing quills in the designated direction. Damage dealt by quills increases the longer power is charged, but movement speed is decreased while charging. If this move hits after power is charged to the maximum, it can stitch the opposing Pokémon's shadow to the ground. The affected Pokémon receives damaqe upon moving a set distance from that location, and its movement speed is decreased for a short time. Decidueye can store up to 3 arrows.

Upgrade (Level 11): Deals increased damage to enemies with low remaining HP.
decidueye.astonish: Deals damage to opposing Pokémon and decreases their movement speed for a short time.
decidueye.leaf storm:
Creates a tempest of sharp leaves, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and decreasing their movement speed for a short time. At point-blank range, it also shoves opposing Pokémon it hits.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases the length of time that the movement speed of enemies is decreased.
decidueye.shadow sneak:

decidueye.nock nock: Fires quills in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon. decidueye.long reach: Deals increased damage to distant enemies.

delphox.ember: Has the user shoot a small flame in front of itself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon if it hits.
delphox.fire blast:

Upgrade (Level 11): Increased damage.
delphox.mystical fire:
Has the user unleash a special, hot ball of fire in a forward direction. If it hits an opposing Pokémon, the fire will explode, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect.

Upgrade (Level 11): Also reduces cooldowns of all moves if this move hits. If it hits an enemy from the opposing team, cooldowns are reduced even further.
delphox.will-o-wisp: Has the user conjure up three sinister flames and launch them toward the designated area. These flames then explode, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit by the explosion and decreasing their movement speed for a short time.
delphox.fire spin:
Has the user create a vortex of fire in the designated area. The vortex automatically moves toward the nearest opposing Pokémon caught in the area of effect for a short time and decreasing their movement speed. After a set amount of time passes or an opposing Pokémon is caught in the center of the vortex, the flames increase in intensity. Upgrade (Level 13): Applies a debuff on trap activation that increases all damage dealt by Delphox by 15% while enemies are trapped. Debuff is only cleansable after the first tick of trap damage and does not re-apply the debuff.
delphox.flame charge:
Has the user charge forward in the designated direction. If there are any opposing Pokémon in range when the charge ends, the user summons three flames to attack. Upgrade (Level 13): Increases Delphox's movement speed for a short time when this move is used.
delphox.fanciful fireworks: Deals damage over time to opposing Pokémon in the designated area of effect. Opposing Pokémon that are hit have decreased movement speed and weakened HP recovery effects for a short time.
delphox.blaze: When the Pokémon uses a move while at a low remaining HP, it deals additional damage with a fireball to opposing Pokémon. This Ability goes on cooldown after it's triggered.

dodrio.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing consecutive blows with each of the user's heads. If this charging attack hits an enemy, all of the user's move cooldowns are reduced.
dodrio.peck: Has the user move forward while jabbing with its beaks. When the sprint gauge is full, the user instead charges forward while jabbing with its beaks. Using this move fully consumes the sprint gauge.
dodrio.tri attack:
Has the user attack with its beaks in a cone in front of itself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and applying one of the following random effects: a decrease to Attack and damage over time for a set amount of time, a decrease to basic attack speed, or a decrease to movement speed. dodrio.drill peck:

Using this move fully consumes the sprint gauge.

Upgrade (Level 11): Reduces this move's cooldown. Also, when this move hits enemies, restore a portion of Dodrio's HP based on the amount of damage dealt.
dodrio.quick attack: Has the user dash forward, increasing its movement speed for a short time and dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits. This move's cooldown is reduced if it hits opposing Pokémon.

dodrio.jump kick:

dragonite.extreme speed:

garchomp.dragon claw:
Has the user attack twice in front of itself using its claws. The first attack deals damage to the opposing Pokémon and then throws them. The second deals increased damage and decreases the movement speed of the opposing Pokémon for a short time.

gardevoir.moonblast:

gengar.sludge bomb:
